name: Collaboration Room
personality: The Collaboration room thrives on interaction and teamwork. This energetic space encourages active discussion, brainstorming, and group project work. Designed for creative exchange, it provides tools and furniture that facilitate collaborative learning while respecting that productive group work can be animated.
rules: Reserve space through the booking system for group meetings
Clean whiteboards and shared surfaces after use
Return furniture to standard configuration when done
Be mindful of time limits during high-demand periods
atmosphere: Energetic, collaborative, bright lighting, movable furniture, multiple whiteboards, comfortable for extended group sessions, acoustic panels to reduce echo

entities.description: Maintains comfortable temperature for active group work at 20°C
Large interactive whiteboard for group brainstorming and presentations
Tracks group sizes and room utilization for booking optimization
Audio system for presentations and group multimedia projects
Displays welcome message and room guidelines when groups enter
Bright, energizing LED lighting to support active collaboration
